20240220-hosted-downloads-1.title: Switch to the updated download experience
20240220-hosted-downloads-1.message: For additional formats and speed and performance improvements, enable "extract" on this item's service.

20240220-hosted-downloads-2.title: Download enhancements are here!
20240220-hosted-downloads-2.message: Enhancements to downloads on your Hub sites include support for hosted downloads, an updated look & feel for download cards, and a new progress bar for downloads.

20240220-hosted-downloads-3.title: Hosted downloads are here!
20240220-hosted-downloads-3.message: Hosted downloads help improve performance when downloading content. To enable hosted downloads, be sure to allow Extract Capabilities below.

202404-aboutworkspaces-basic.title: About workspaces
202404-aboutworkspaces-basic.message:
Add content to Site catalogs using groups
Site search catalogs have always been powered by groups, and workspaces make it easier to manage those groups. For now, add content to individual groups connected to your site to have them appear in the site catalog. Soon, you will be able to add content to your catalog directly.

Transitioning from Teams to Groups
You can now use any ArcGIS Online Group to collaborate on sites, pages, content, and projects in Hub. All previously linked "Teams", such as the site's "Core Team", will still appear in the Collaborators pane of Site workspace.

Team-based email messaging temporarily paused
Sending email messages and invitation/removal emails to team members and followers is not currently supported.

Deprecation of embedded Survey123 website designer
We embedded the Survey123 designer to help you get more done in Hub. However, customer feedback indicated a preference for survey design and management in Survey123, just like other applications. Thus, we are deprecating support for the embedded Survey123 designer in ArcGIS Hub to better align with your desired workflow.

202404-aboutworkspaces-premium.title: About workspaces
202404-aboutworkspaces-premium.message:
Add content to Site catalogs using groups
Site search catalogs have always been powered by groups, and workspaces make it easier to manage those groups. For now, add content to individual groups connected to your site to have them appear in the site catalog. Soon, you will be able to add content to your catalog directly.

Transitioning from Supporting Teams to Groups
You can now use any ArcGIS Online Group to collaborate on sites, pages, content, and projects in Hub. All previously linked Supporting Teams will still appear in the Collaborators pane of Site workspace. For continued support, add those Supporting teams as Groups that can View and Groups that can Edit.

Team-based email messaging temporarily paused
Sending email messages and invitation/removal emails to team members and followers is not currently supported.

Deprecation of embedded Survey123 website designer
We embedded the Survey123 designer to help you get more done in Hub. However, customer feedback indicated a preference for survey design and management in Survey123, just like other applications. Thus, we are deprecating support for the embedded Survey123 designer in ArcGIS Hub to better align with your desired workflow.

Events not yet available in workspaces
Events are going through a transformation and should be available soon within workspaces. For now, if you opt-in to workspaces, you will lose the ability to create new events, manage and search existing events. However, if you would like to manage previously created events, you can opt-out at any time.

202404-workspaceannouncement.title: Introducing workspaces
202404-workspaceannouncement.message: Workspaces are the new way to edit and manage items in Hub, replacing the global navigation in edit view (not live view). In this phase, you can "opt in" (at any time) to use workspaces and associated features for items and groups. Events will be available in a later phase. To try out workspaces now, select "Go to settings."

20240517-initiatives-introducing.title: Re-Introducing — Hub Initiatives
20240517-initiatives-introducing.message: ArcGIS Hub Initiatives changed on July 2, 2024. Previously created initiatives are now standalone sites — with the same layouts, content, URLs, and premium features (like followers and events) as before. To try out new refreshed initiatives, you must enable workspaces.

20240517-initiatives-introducing-site.title: Re-Introducing — Hub Initiatives
20240517-initiatives-introducing-site.message: The new generation of Hub Initiatives is now available in workspaces. Initiatives have their own, easy to set-up view and can help align Hub Projects that share long-term goals. Initiatives can be created independently, and they can be shared with one or more sites. Sites can feature one or more initiatives.

20240710-slow-service-warning.title: Service interruption
20240710-slow-service-warning.message: Communication with the service is taking longer than expected. This may affect your access to downloads and map functionality.

20240710-unreachable-service-error.title: Service unavailable
20240710-unreachable-service-error.message: We are unable to contact the host service. Downloads and map functionality are currently unavailable for this item.

20240807-auth-required-status.title: Service status unknown
20240807-auth-required-status.message: We are unable to access the secure service as it requires additional authorization. Downloads and map functionality are currently unavailable for the item.
